title: EEZ Composer queue
description: Composer-owned cross-chain queue membership. Native Reth chain metrics are not used because embedded L1 and L2 share a recorder.

panels.title: Cross-chain queue
panels.description: Queued requests await composition, including blocked or not-yet-evaluated requests. In-flight requests are reserved for composition or awaiting settlement evidence. These are disjoint states; a move between them is not proof of completion. Inbound originates on L1; outbound originates on L2. Missing or stale telemetry stays a gap, never zero. The queue is in memory and may reset on restart.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",state="queued"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",state="in_flight"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Last-evaluated queue readiness
panels.description: Cached ready / blocked / awaiting-evaluation classifications of queued requests across both directions. They sum to queued membership in each pool snapshot. A fresh sample does not establish a recent evaluation; readiness can remain cached while idle. In-flight work is excluded. Awaiting evaluation means no valid ready/blocked classification is recorded for the current evaluated source state; this includes new requests and invalidated earlier evaluations.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_queue_readiness_requests{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Last-evaluated blocking reasons
panels.description: Queued requests blocked by nonce, fee, balance or escrow, including affected successors. Across both directions. These are cached observations from the last evaluated source state. They can remain cached while idle.

targets.expr: reth_eez_composer_queue_blocked_requests{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Oldest tracked pending request
panels.description: Age since the earliest retained in-memory admission among queued and in-flight requests. Replacement starts a new admission. Recovery preserves retained timestamps. Empty queue or missing history is unknown, never a zero age. Last is the last plotted sample. The Oldest age metrics card at the top uses two-second samples independently of plot resolution. This is not end-to-end transaction latency.

targets.expr: ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_oldest_pending_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)

panels.title: Outstanding requests
panels.description: All held requests: queued plus in-flight. Inbound originates on L1; outbound on L2. These are outstanding requests, not completed transaction counts. Instant snapshot at the selected end time (now for a live time range), refreshed every five seconds. Stale or missing telemetry shows Unavailable, never an empty queue. Individual gauge reads may straddle an update.

targets.expr: scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",direction="inbound"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",direction="outbound"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

panels.title: Processing
panels.description: Queued requests await composition. In-flight requests are reserved for composition or awaiting settlement evidence. The two states are disjoint and sum to outstanding requests. Instant snapshot at the selected end time (now for a live time range), refreshed every five seconds. Stale or missing telemetry shows Unavailable, never an empty queue. Individual gauge reads may straddle an update.

targets.expr: scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",state="queued"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",state="in_flight"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

panels.title: Queued readiness
panels.description: Breakdown of queued requests across both directions. Ready + blocked + awaiting evaluation = queued in each pool snapshot. Readiness is cached from the last valid source-state evaluation; in-flight requests are excluded. Instant snapshot at the selected end time (now for a live time range), refreshed every five seconds. Stale or missing telemetry shows Unavailable, never an empty queue. Individual gauge reads may straddle an update.

targets.expr: scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_readiness_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",status="ready"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_readiness_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",status="blocked"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

scalar(sum(reth_eez_composer_queue_readiness_requests{job="eez-composer-reth",status="unknown"} and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1)))

panels.title: Oldest age metrics
panels.description: Minimum, maximum and arithmetic mean of the oldest tracked pending-request age, evaluated every two seconds over the selected period. Only valid nonempty-queue samples contribute; missing, stale and empty-queue observations are excluded. Average describes the oldest-age signal while requests are present, not mean waiting time per transaction. Peaks between samples can still be missed. A dash means no valid observations in the selected range.

targets.expr: scalar(min_over_time((((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_oldest_pending_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1))[$__range:2s]))

scalar(max_over_time((((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_oldest_pending_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1))[$__range:2s]))

scalar(avg_over_time((((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_oldest_pending_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= 0) and on(job, instance, rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1))[$__range:2s]))

panels.title: Current unresolved submission
panels.description: Oldest unresolved local attempt. Prepared starts after proving; Dispatched means the submission gate was crossed. Receipt observed does not establish completion of every cross-chain request. Idle means no unresolved local attempt. Short states can occur between scrapes; the posting history below records individual events.

targets.expr: scalar(sum without(state) ((0 * reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth",state="none"}) or (1 * reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth",state="prepared"}) or (2 * reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth",state="dispatched"}) or (3 * reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth",state="included"}) or (4 * reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth",state="excluded"}) or (5 * reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth",state="uncertain"})) and on(job,instance,rollup_id) (sum without(state) (reth_eez_composer_settlement_submission{job="eez-composer-reth"}) == 1) and on(job,instance,rollup_id) (((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) >= -3) and ((time() - reth_eez_composer_queue_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="eez-composer-reth"}) < 10)) and on(job,instance) (up{job="eez-composer-reth"} == 1))

panels.title: Settlement trigger reasons
panels.description: Reasons captured for prepared posting attempts in each time bucket. Several reasons can apply to one attempt, so the stacked total counts reasons rather than unique attempts. Unavailable means no applicable policy context was captured. Retries are separate attempts; periods without postings have no bars.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.time, '$__interval'),
CASE r.reason WHEN 'general' THEN 'Block threshold' WHEN 'pure_always' THEN 'L2 activity' WHEN 'pure_interval' THEN 'L2 interval' WHEN 'cross_chain' THEN 'Cross-chain work' WHEN 'blob_fullness' THEN 'Blob fullness' WHEN 'drain' THEN 'Remaining batch work' WHEN 'window_limit' THEN 'Batch window limit' ELSE 'Unavailable' END AS metric,
count(*)::double precision AS value
FROM eez_indexer.posting_attempts p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT DISTINCT value AS reason FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(nullif(nullif(p.trigger_reasons,'null'::jsonb),'[]'::jsonb),'["unavailable"]'::jsonb))) r
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Posting submissions
panels.description: One row per local submission attempt, with reasons captured before its observer starts. Timings are measured inside that attempt: Prepared → dispatch excludes preceding proof work. Receipt observed is the submitter’s observation; Chain status is joined to current indexed canonical commitments. Missing events flags incomplete retained history. Different attempts at the same L2 height remain separate. History is Intact when the recorded sequence through its latest stage has no missing events. Expected L1 block/time are captured at dispatch. Target result compares the canonical inclusion height with that target; block difference is actual minus expected. Receipt observation delay is the local receipt-event time minus the canonical block timestamp, not inclusion delay. Wall-clock differences require a synchronized host clock. Missing canonical data stays unavailable. Outcome separates local deferral, canonical skipped slots and observed omission from a produced block. External omission reasons remain unknown. Preparation-failure durations end before the first proof call; successful durations measure prepared to dispatch.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.time AS "Prepared / first seen", p.l2_block AS "L2 block",
CASE WHEN p.trigger_reasons IS NULL OR p.trigger_reasons='null'::jsonb THEN 'Unavailable'
 ELSE (SELECT string_agg(CASE r WHEN 'general' THEN 'Block threshold' WHEN 'pure_always' THEN 'L2 activity' WHEN 'pure_interval' THEN 'L2 interval' WHEN 'cross_chain' THEN 'Cross-chain work' WHEN 'blob_fullness' THEN 'Blob fullness' WHEN 'drain' THEN 'Remaining batch work' WHEN 'window_limit' THEN 'Batch window limit' END, ', ') FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p.trigger_reasons) AS r) END AS "Trigger reasons",
p.outcome AS "Latest stage", p.explanation AS "Reason",
coalesce(p.preparation_ms,(p.detail->>'preparation_ms')::double precision) AS "Preparation / dispatch duration", p.observation_ms AS "Dispatch → outcome",
coalesce(p.canonical_l1_block,(p.detail->>'l1_block')::bigint) AS "L1 block",
p.target_l1_block AS "Expected L1 block", p.expected_l1_time AS "Expected L1 time",
p.included_l1_time AS "Included L1 time", p.target_result AS "Target result",
p.inclusion_block_delta AS "Block difference", p.receipt_observation_seconds AS "Receipt observation delay",
p.transaction_hash AS "L1 transaction", p.chain_status AS "Chain status",
CASE WHEN c.checked_at IS NULL OR c.checked_at < now()-interval '15 seconds' THEN 'Collector unavailable'
     WHEN c.error IS NOT NULL THEN 'Collector error' ELSE p.history END AS "History",
p.attempt_id AS "Attempt", p.posting_id AS "L2 hash"
FROM eez_indexer.posting_diagnostics p LEFT JOIN eez_indexer.posting_collection c ON true
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) ORDER BY p.time DESC,p.attempt_id DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Posting timing & outcomes
panels.description: Each attempt is positioned at its expected L1 timestamp. Left axis: seconds before/after that timestamp; zero is the target. Prepared is after proving and before final repricing. Colored outcome markers use an independent hidden scale near the top, not counts or durations. Hover the event marker below the plot for attempt ID, expected block, outcome and reason. Multiple attempts can share a target; their event details remain separate. Attempts without a recorded target appear only in Posting submissions. Canonical inclusion/receipt timing stays absent until supported by canonical evidence. No interpolation; wall-clock offsets can reflect host clock skew.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.expected_l1_time AS time,
(SELECT max((e.data->>'timestamp_ms')::bigint) / 1000.0 - extract(epoch FROM p.expected_l1_time)
 FROM eez_indexer.posting_events e
 WHERE e.attempt_id=p.attempt_id AND e.data->>'stage'='prepared')::double precision AS "Prepared",
p.dispatch_vs_target_seconds::double precision AS "Dispatch",
p.inclusion_vs_target_seconds AS "Canonical inclusion",
p.receipt_vs_target_seconds::double precision AS "Receipt observed"
FROM eez_indexer.posting_timing p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.expected_l1_time)
ORDER BY p.expected_l1_time,p.attempt_id

SELECT p.expected_l1_time AS time, p.outcome AS metric, 1::double precision AS value
FROM eez_indexer.posting_diagnostics p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.expected_l1_time)
ORDER BY p.expected_l1_time,p.attempt_id

custom.axisLabel: Seconds relative to expected L1 timestamp

target.rawSql:
SELECT p.expected_l1_time AS time, concat('Outcome: ',p.outcome,'
Attempt: ',p.attempt_id, '
Expected L1 block: ',p.target_l1_block,'
L2 sync block: ',p.l2_block, '
Reason: ',p.explanation,'
L1 transaction: ',coalesce(p.transaction_hash,'Not signed')) AS text, p.outcome AS tags FROM eez_indexer.posting_diagnostics p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.expected_l1_time) ORDER BY p.expected_l1_time,p.attempt_id
